security_audit.summary: Four archive-extraction findings are confirmed because untrusted Office ZIP files are extracted without resource limits. Most static matches are benign documentation, OOXML schemas, or expected presentation tooling. Additional review found resource-exhaustion and path-containment concerns when processing untrusted files. Static review was capped at 400/491 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 91 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Unbounded extraction of Office ZIP archives
remediation.suggestion: Validate archive member paths and enforce entry-count, uncompressed-size, and compression-ratio limits before extraction.

remediation.issue: Relationship targets can escape the package root
remediation.suggestion: Resolve targets and reject any path outside the canonical unpacked package directory.
Run LibreOffice and PDF rendering with timeouts, resource limits, and sandboxing for untrusted files.

remediation.issue: XML parsing has no resource bounds
remediation.suggestion: Limit extracted XML sizes and use hardened parser settings before validating untrusted packages.

semantic_findings.title: Relationship validation can probe paths outside the package
semantic_findings.description: Relationship targets are resolved without enforcing containment under the unpacked package directory. A crafted relationship can test whether host paths exist.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The target-resolution logic checks resolved paths but does not show a package-root containment check. This supports filesystem existence probing, not arbitrary file reads.

semantic_findings.title: Office conversion lacks resource containment
semantic_findings.description: Thumbnail generation opens supplied presentations with LibreOffice and renders pages without a timeout or resource limits. Malformed documents can consume CPU or memory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The conversion commands process a supplied presentation and the reviewed invocation lacks a timeout. The impact is resource exhaustion and exposure to the local converter.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded XML parsing of untrusted package data
semantic_findings.description: Validation parses OOXML XML files without documented size or resource limits. Large crafted XML can amplify resource consumption after extraction.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The validator parses package XML directly and no input-size bounds are evident at these parser call sites. This is a resource-exhaustion concern for untrusted documents.

content.value_statement: Building accurate PowerPoint files often requires layout, XML, and rendering knowledge. This skill provides structured workflows for creating, editing, inspecting, and validating PPTX presentations.
actual_capabilities: Create PowerPoint slides from HTML with the included html2pptx workflow.
Inspect PPTX text, layouts, themes, comments, notes, and raw OOXML files.
Reorder, duplicate, or remove slides with the provided presentation utilities.
Generate slide inventories and thumbnail grids for presentation review.
Pack and validate edited OOXML presentation packages.
limitations: It requires local Python, Node.js, and supporting presentation tools.
Complex charts, embedded objects, and unsupported OOXML features may need manual review.
Visual output can vary across PowerPoint, LibreOffice, and operating systems.
Use only trusted presentation files or isolate processing of untrusted files.

use_cases.title: Create a sales deck
use_cases.description: Generate a consistent slide deck from a structured outline and approved brand styles.

use_cases.title: Update a template presentation
use_cases.description: Inspect an existing template, map its layouts, and produce a revised PPTX.

use_cases.title: Review presentation quality
use_cases.description: Extract content and thumbnails to identify layout, contrast, and text-overflow issues.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint about [topic]. Use a clear title, concise bullets, and speaker notes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a branded deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10-slide PPTX about [topic]. Use these colors: [colors]. Include a title, agenda, evidence, and conclusion.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an existing presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [file.pptx], summarize its layouts and theme, then update slides [numbers] with this content: [content].

prompt_templates.title: Validate an advanced deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PPTX from [outline] and [template.pptx]. Generate thumbnails, review each slide, and fix overflow or contrast problems.

output_examples.input: Create a five-slide project update for leadership.
output: A presentation with title, progress, milestones, risks, and next steps.
Speaker notes and a visual review checklist for each slide.

output_examples.input: Review this template presentation before creating a new deck.
output: A layout inventory with slide roles, typography, colors, and reusable design patterns.

output_examples.input: Update slides 3 and 5 in an existing presentation.
output: A revised PPTX and a summary of the edited slides.

best_practices: Inspect the template theme and layouts before creating new slides.
Generate thumbnails and review every slide before delivery.
Keep source files and generated outputs in a dedicated workspace.
anti_patterns: Do not process untrusted PPTX files without isolation and resource limits.
Do not edit OOXML relationships without validating the final package.
Do not rely on generated slides without visual review.

faq.question: What files can this skill use?
faq.answer: It focuses on PowerPoint PPTX files and their OOXML package contents.

faq.question: Can it create presentations from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides an HTML to PPTX workflow for new presentations.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing presentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect, modify, pack, and validate presentation content.

faq.question: Does it support speaker notes and comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The OOXML workflow includes guidance for notes and comments.

faq.question: How should I review generated slides?
faq.answer: Generate thumbnail grids and check text, alignment, contrast, and overflow.

faq.question: Should I process unknown PPTX files?
faq.answer: Use an isolated environment because crafted archives can consume system resources.
